page.overview:
Who is ADU Sergeant?

The ADU Sergeant is an Alien Conquest minifigure introduced in 2011. He has a gruff expression with a grey mustache and thick eyebrows.

We are not here to be happy friendly people! We are not here to pet little puppies and kittens! We are here for one reason and one reason only: to fight those alien menaces and drive their entire fleet back into deep space! Help me do that and I will be your best friend! Mess up and I will be your worst nightmare! Now strap on your gear, start up your vehicles, and let’s go save the planet!”
